partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Each of the four AI partners has its own account and bond, and the hash of its instructions is recorded in the contract, so each can be checked.
partners.hashMatches: The hash on chain matches the instructions running now
partners.hashDiffers: The hash on chain does not match the instructions running now
partners.hashMissing: No hash of the instructions has been published on chain yet
partners.candidatesHint: These accounts published a profile but hold no seat. Investors can move to seat one on the Investors page.

investors.title: Investors
investors.description: Investors put money into the fund for shares, share in the fund by them, and by them veto deals and replace partners.
investors.depositHint: Deposits turn into shares at the fund's value at the time.
investors.redeemHint: Takes your share of what the fund has not invested yet.
investors.vetoesHint: Until the second tranche is paid, investors can veto a deal by the shares they held when the committee approved it. Once half of those shares agree, the veto takes effect: what was not paid goes back to the fund, and each partner who approved loses a fifth of their bond.
investors.noVetoable: No deals can be vetoed right now.
investors.noWeight: You held no shares when the committee approved it.
investors.notVetoable: This deal can no longer be vetoed.
investors.motionPending: Someone has just proposed this veto. Try again to support it.
investors.candidateUnfit: The candidate must publish a profile and post the full bond first.
investors.seatsHint: Investors can give a seat to a bonded candidate or leave it vacant, once half of the shares agree.
investors.candidatePlaceholder: Leave empty to leave the seat vacant

join.title: Join the fund
join.description: The organisers deposit the same amount of test dollars for everyone in the room and turn it into shares of the fund. With shares you can vote to veto the deals the committee approves.
join.full: The fund has taken in everyone it can for now.
join.failed: Could not join. Try again later.
join.preparing: Getting ready. You can vote in a few seconds.

landing.lead: The room scans a code to invest, founders scan one to pitch. Four partners review each pitch on the spot and vote on chain, the money is paid in two tranches, and the investors can veto it together.
landing.numbersHint: Every figure is read from the contracts and updates with each new block.

pitch.title: Submit a pitch
pitch.body: Give the contract address and describe the project. The gas is paid for you.

review.title: Partners review
review.body: Each partner reads the contract, does its research and votes from its own account.

terms.title: Set the terms
terms.body: With three votes in favour, the risk and finance partner sets the amount, the first tranche and the milestone deadline.

accept.title: Accept the offer
accept.body: Once the founder accepts, the first tranche and a portfolio badge arrive.

milestone.title: Check the milestone
milestone.body: The founder reports the milestone, and the second tranche is paid once the partners approve it.

veto.title: Investors veto
veto.body: Before the second tranche, investors can veto by share, and the unpaid money returns to the fund.

landing.partnersRest: each voting from its own account
landing.partnersHint: Every partner has posted a bond, and the hash of its prompt is registered in the contract for anyone to check.
landing.rulesHint: These rules are written into the contracts and cannot be changed by anyone once deployed.

rules.quorum: At least three of the four partners must vote in favour before the fund invests.
rules.tranches: The money is paid in two tranches, the second only once the milestone is approved.
rules.veto: Before the second tranche, investors holding {percent}% of the shares can veto the deal.
rules.slash: When a deal is vetoed, each partner who voted for it loses {percent}% of its bond.

landing.closingHint: Give the contract address and describe the project. The four partners review it on the spot.
